name: IOICORP
recent: IOI Corporation Berhad 于 2026 年 11 月 4 日举行第 57 届常年股东大会，所有普通决议案均获通过。公司宣布委任 Dato' Yeo How 为独立非执行董事，并有多项 EPF 持股变动申报。此外，公司宣布与 TNB 合作开发 500 MWac 太阳能及 1 GWh 电池储能系统，并预期 FY27 棕油产量录得单位数增长。
notable: 第 57 届常年股东大会于 2026 年 11 月 4 日举行，所有普通决议案获股东通过。
Dato' Yeo How 于 2026 年 11 月 6 日获委任为独立非执行董事，并加入审计委员会。
公司与 TNB 合作在马来西亚开发 500 MWac 太阳能及 1 GWh 电池储能系统。
risks: EPF 在 2026 年 10 月至 11 月期间多次申报持股变动。
集团董事经理 Dato' Lee Yeow Chor 及非独立非执行董事 Dato' Lee Yeow Seng 在闭市期前表示有意进行证券交易。
earnings: 截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度，营收为 MYR 3,041.7 million，按季增长 13.7%，按年增长 2.8%；净利为 MYR 500.8 million，按季增长 76.8%，按年增长 14.7%；净利率为 16.5%，高于上一季度的 10.6%。

recent_en: IOI Corporation Berhad held its 57th Annual General Meeting on 4 November 2026, with all ordinary resolutions passed. The company announced the appointment of Dato' Yeo How as Independent Non-Executive Director and several EPF shareholding change notifications. It also announced a partnership with TNB for a 500 MWac solar and 1 GWh BESS project, and expects single-digit palm oil production growth for FY27.
notable_en: The 57th AGM was held on 4 November 2026, with all ordinary resolutions passed by shareholders.
Dato' Yeo How was appointed as Independent Non-Executive Director and joined the Audit Committee on 6 November 2026.
The company partnered with TNB to develop a 500 MWac solar and 1 GWh battery energy storage system in Malaysia.
risks_en: EPF filed multiple shareholding change notifications between October and November 2026.
Group Managing Director Dato' Lee Yeow Chor and Non-Independent Non-Executive Director Dato' Lee Yeow Seng indicated intention to deal in securities during the closed period.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR 3,041.7 million, up 13.7% QoQ and 2.8% YoY; net income was MYR 500.8 million, up 76.8% QoQ and 14.7% YoY; net margin was 16.5%, higher than 10.6% in the previous quarter.
